scientific_question: Does exactly one new law—finite-energy local diffusion of B/H-unbound monomers—create geometrically available four-cell corridors and physically distinct informative offspring from the first spontaneous native B4 chain under otherwise unchanged M8.0 local chemistry?

provenance.previous_negative: M8.1a native source YES, offspring NO_GO; retrospective audit: 0/30 first sources had fully vacant four-site adjacent corridor in active mode
provenance.not_a_confirmatory_replication: Exploratory mechanism test designed after seeing M8.1a null; new fixed numeric seed set, preregistered prospectively.

physics.only_physical_extension: At each new tick after existing H/B breaks and before existing M8.0 local capture and B formation, loop persistent material IDs in increasing order. If particle is currently free of ALL B and H bonds, and free-energy budget ≥1, with probability 0.25 attempt a hop to one of four cardinal directions chosen uniformly by a second keyed draw. Only execute when destination is inside the existing closed 10x5 lattice and unoccupied. Each successful hop consumes 1 available energy unit irreversibly dissipated, changes x/y of the SAME material ID, never changes species, bath, atom count, B/H or source/genotype.
physics.decisions: M8.0 key-based RNG for preexisting physical channels is unchanged; new independently keyed hop attempt and cardinal-direction draws use seed/tick/current position/material ID.
physics.tick_order: existing H and B break => NEW hop over IDs ascending => existing M8.0 adsorption/H capture => existing M8.0 B-formation => original per-tick ledger assertion
physics.status_bonded: Any particle with ≥1 B or H remains immobile. No B/H link may be moved, stretched, cut or cloned by hop.
physics.event: Record tick, native material ID, from (x,y), to (x,y), cost=1. Decrease free energy and increase dissipated energy by 1.
physics.no_other_changes: Original probabilities P_CAPTURE P_MATCH P_BACKGROUND P_B_BASE P_B_CATALYZED P_H_RELEASE P_B_BREAK remain exactly M8.0; no monomer birth other than existing bath capture; no desorption; no exchange; no global fitness or copy instruction; no extra diffusion of bonded structures.

frozen_experiment.shared_initial_conditions: Use original M8.1a initial_feedstock(seed) exactly, with 20 unbonded monomers, 10 of each species in 20 of 50 distinct cells, 60 left in bath, initial free energy 500, B=H=0, no seeded template. All four arms same IDs/species/sites at tick 0.
frozen_experiment.independent_unit: One numeric seed is independent; four intervention arms matched by seed. Include every null, no seed tuning or trial replacement.

first_source_endpoint: First tick and (y,x) lexicographically earliest native contiguous horizontal B-connected four monomers consisting entirely of original 20 unbonded IDs. All 3 B bonds formed by original native B_form events; observer never manufactures source. Source only scored once per world and cannot be reselected to a later favorable candidate.
corridor_endpoint: At each tick after first source birth, inspect two rows directly above/below original source x-span (4 cells). A corridor is free only if all 4 positions are unoccupied simultaneously. Record whether corridor free at source birth and whether any such corridor observed at or after birth, together with first free time and cumulative free-corridor ticks. No posthoc relocation of source.
offspring_endpoint: Exactly the M8.1a strict first-source criterion: each of four new material IDs adsorbed AFTER parent birth at respective aligned adjacent cell with native H-capture whose source_material_id equals corresponding original parent ID; three actual adjacent B links; complete resulting B component exactly four IDs; no H tether to any source material; exact stable material IDs/species/topology ≥20 consecutive ticks. Informative offspring additionally exact match of parent 4-bit composition, counted by source-world not child.
audits: All 256 worlds full exact M8 matter/energy ledger each tick; no B or H t0; same original 20 IDs and same material budget; deterministic full replay of fixed seed; every hop physically legal/no linked atom movement and charges energy; other modes have zero hops.
On static_templated arm, compare first 200 ticks and first-source metadata against unchanged M8.1a physics output for the same fresh seed (not against old seed values).
Audit complete native events, source identity, local-corridor snapshots, true capture provenance, first persistent product and world-level nulls.

Report both total adsorptions and first-source captures in all arms; chemistry plus geometry may differ after intervention, so no claim that aggregate reactive opportunities are perfectly rate-matched.

frozen_gates.integrity: 256/256 exact physical ledger, legal hop event and replay controls pass; otherwise INVALID software experiment.
frozen_gates.corridor_effect: At least 8/64 hop_templated source worlds have a free 4-site corridor at or AFTER first source birth, and at least 5 MORE worlds than static_templated arm. Both thresholds required; else NO_GO for this fixed hypothesis.
frozen_gates.informative_product: At least 3/64 hop_templated worlds have a strictly traced informative persistent product AND at least 3 MORE worlds than hop_shuffled. This is distinct from corridor effect; failure is a scientific null and does NOT fail software CI.
frozen_gates.transparent_null: All 64 seed worlds included in every arm, even when no source exists. Never enlarge horizon, change mobility probability or try more seed numbers after outcomes without separate new preregistration.

scope_limitations: Single particle-hop law can move ONLY unbonded material, cannot dislodge bonded obstruction; a geometrical NO_GO would support testing a separately versioned desorption/turnover hypothesis, not automatically adjusting hop rate. Observed parent-to-product copying is NOT three generations, metabolism, selection, or life.
